title: Atlas 1.1 — Dependency Graph
description: Derived, regenerable graph merging atlas-state.json component topology with evidence-registry.json branch links. Never hand-edited; regenerate with tools/generate_dependency_graph.py.

nodes.description: verbatim copy of atlas-state.json nodes (id, name, state, status, deps, year)

edges.description: verbatim copy of atlas-state.json edges (from, to)

evidence_links.description: one entry per evidence-registry.json item whose 'branch' field exactly matches an atlas-state.json node id

unlinked_items.description: evidence-registry.json item ids whose 'branch' field does not exactly match any atlas-state.json node id. Not guessed or fuzzy-matched.
